newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks slip, but close off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks slip, but close off early lows.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged on Sunday amid panic selling one day after a bomb blast in Lahore in which 26 people, including the leader of a militant Sunni Moslem faction, died, dealers said.
But the index bounced back near the close, wiping out some of the early losses on hopes that the blast would not trigger more sectarian violence, they said.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 11.96 points, or 0.82 percent, to end at 1,440.76. The index had dropped to 1,426.68 in early trade. Losers led gainers 131 to 60. Turnover fell to 22 million shares from 29 million in the previous session.

Bank of Punjab fell 0.30 rupees to 18.45 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.70 to 32.05. D.G. Khan Cement fell 0.50 to 10.50. Hub Power Co rose 0.10 to 37 but Sui Northern Gas fell 1.25 to 34.25. PTCL fell 1.05 to 28.55. Fauji Fertilizer fell 1.0 to 72.50 and ICI Pakistan 0.30 to 18.20.
